command: Inspect JDBC starter auto-configuration, candidate annotations, canonical datasource/transaction wiring, and module test capability
actualResult: ConditionalOnSingleCandidate is not repeatable, but the method intends to require unambiguous candidates for both DataSource and PlatformTransactionManager. Removing either condition would weaken multi-bean fail-closed wiring. Preserve both by placing the DataSource condition on a nested configuration and the transaction-manager condition on its bean method. Add ApplicationContextRunner regressions proving a single pair creates CpfNamedParameterJdbcOperations and ambiguity on either axis suppresses it.
